name: The Science of Location
source:
A short visual novel on stories, location, and machines.

You are the control group for a study. In this visual novel the character you control ("you") will talk to a scientist and a machine. There are two distinct ending and several paths to chose to reach them. The playtime is about 4 minutes, give or take.

This Visual Novel is tangentially related and definitely a part of the "THE" series, which is a group of comics made from 2017 to present times.

[from [url=https://jellyfishlover.itch.io/the-science-of-location]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于故事、地点和机器的视觉短篇小说。

你是一项研究的对照组。在这部视觉小说中，你控制的角色（“你”）将与科学家和机器交谈。有两个不同的结局和多种到达它们的路径。游戏时间大约为4分钟，或多或少。

这部视觉小说与“THE”系列无关，绝对是“THE”系列的一部分，“THE”系列是一组从2017年至今制作的漫画。

[来自[url=https://jellyfishlover.itch.io/the-science-of-location]Itch.io[/url]]
